title: Hollow Reflection
text: The Reach sees an empty shape where allies try to stand.
flavor: Your reflection accepts help. You do not.
origin: A breach duplicated the operative's outline but left the inner signal absent.
adaptationText: Once per round, reroll one Guile die.

effect.text: Hollow Reflection severed the offered assistance.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: Once per round, reroll one Guile die.
